item.title: In Conversation with John Linford on Cybersecurity and the Power of Open Standards (Source: blog.opengroup.org)
item.description: By Ash Patel - CDMP - Certified Copywriter (CMP) - CDMA, Content Marketing Manager, The Open Group We recently sat down with John Linford, Security Portfolio Forum Director at The Open Group, to look beyond his role within the organization and explore his recent experiences as a guest on external cybersecurity podcasts. John Linford is the Forum Director of The Open Group Security Forum, Open Trusted Technology Forum, and Assured Dependability Work Group. As staff at The Open Group, John supports the leaders and participants of the Security Portfolio in utilizing the resources of The Open Group to facilitate collaboration and follow The Open Group Standards process to publish their deliverables. Prior to joining The Open Group in June 2019, John worked as a Lecturer for San Jose State University, teaching courses in Economics. John is Open FAIR™ certified and serves on the Board of Directors of the Society of Information Risk Analysts (SiRA). Continue reading The post In Conversation with John Linford on Cybersecurity and the Power of Open Standards first appeared on The Open Group Blog.

item.title: In Conversation with the Chair of the Open Professions Work Group, Vicky Rose (Source: blog.opengroup.org)
item.description: By Ash Patel - CDMP - Certified Copywriter (CMP) - CDMA, Content Marketing Manager, The Open Group Recently, we reached out to Vicky Rose of Kyndryl Consult to discuss her role as the Chair of The Open Group Governing Board Open Professions Work Group. Vicky is a Principal Enterprise Architect at Kyndryl with over 20 years' experience as an architect and is an Open Professions Certified Distinguished Architect. She is based in the UK, responsible for Kyndryl UK & Ireland Architecture Governance. When Kyndryl was launched as a company in 2021, Vicky was co-leader of the Kyndryl Architect Profession and was instrumental in incorporating The Open Group Open Professions certification as a core tenant of the Kyndryl architect career path.
